name: @btkulka/benhaus-client
description: A client for Benhäus, Ben's desktop hub, from any local app: finds it through ~/.benhaus/mcp.json and calls its tools over the local endpoint. Shares Benhäus's Google sign-ins (Gmail search, threads, replies, labels; calendar events, free/busy included) without each app holding OAuth tokens, posts Benhäus notifications, and reads Settings › Credentials (API keys kept in Benhäus, with an environment fallback). No runtime dependencies.
